sentences.en: A man with a gun urged him into the car.
sentences.zh: 一个持枪的男人敦促他上车。

sentences.en: All forms of life have an instinctive urge to survive.
sentences.zh: 所有生命都有求生的本能冲动。

sentences.en: The urge to brag on his recent successes was irresistible.
sentences.zh: 他忍不住要炫耀自己最近的成功。

senses.zh: 强烈的欲望，迫切要求；推动力
